stats.label: Production ACR repositories scanned with Wiz
Live resources imported into Terraform state

pillars.title: Cloud Infrastructure
pillars.text: Running production and non-production Azure SaaS environments: App Service, Front Door, AKS, Redis, SQL, Private Endpoints.

pillars.title: IaC & CI/CD
pillars.text: Reusable Terraform modules, state imports and Azure DevOps release pipelines that ship with minimal downtime.

pillars.title: Kubernetes
pillars.text: Administering production AKS: upgrades, PDBs, RBAC, CronJobs, PV/PVC, services and ingress.

pillars.title: Security & Compliance
pillars.text: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 with Vanta, Wiz image scanning, CVE fixes and moving to managed identities.

pillars.title: Cost & Automation
pillars.text: Azure Functions, runbooks and Bash automation that cut Fabric costs by ~40% and non-prod compute by ~30%.

highlights.title: Azure Managed Redis migration
highlights.text: Migrated a customer's production caching layer from Azure Cache for Redis to Azure Managed Redis, then brought it under Terraform.

highlights.title: AKS cluster upgrades
highlights.text: Upgraded non-prod and SaaS production AKS through Azure DevOps, tuning PDBs for Redis and ChromaDB.

highlights.title: High-severity RCE fixed
highlights.text: Fixed a Brotli decoder RCE on Azure DevOps build agents by upgrading the Node.js and .NET runtimes.

highlights.title: Managed identities
highlights.text: Moved workloads from stored secrets to system-assigned managed identities, so Redis key auth could be turned off.

highlights.title: Fabric auto pause/resume
highlights.text: Azure Functions pause and resume Microsoft Fabric capacities based on CU utilization.

highlights.title: Container Apps migration
highlights.text: Moved production workloads from ACI to Azure Container Apps with Terraform for better scaling and revision management.
